purpose: Review one finite Campaign138 valuation and capital-structure catalog using only accepted local schema metadata and frozen terminal histories, without requiring high-point provider data or opening any source row, candidate value, comparator value, daily price value or forward return.

accepted_daily_schema_sample.inspection_method: pyarrow.parquet.read_schema only; no row group or column value opened

accepted_local_schema_audit.conclusion: The accepted local point-in-time contract contains OHLCV, amount, turnover and price-basis fields plus already exposed quality/forecast fields; it contains no PE, PB, PS, PCF, market-cap, total-share, free-share or circulating-share field.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_pe_ttm_earnings_yield
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.frozen_hypothetical_formula: 1 / peTTM when peTTM is positive and finite
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.filters: positive finite peTTM only; no winsorization, clipping, neutralization, lag substitution or imputation
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: peTTM is not present in the accepted daily schema. Reading a discarded provider field or fetching a new history would be a new source-admission campaign, not research on the currently accepted data.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_pb_mrq_book_to_market
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.frozen_hypothetical_formula: 1 / pbMRQ or 1 / pb when the selected field is positive and finite
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.filters: positive finite PB only; one provider field only; no transform or universe change
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: No PB field is present in the accepted local daily contract, and the separately admitted Tushare daily PB branch is terminal after capacity, uniqueness, association and execution gates. Its record forbids rerunning, inversion, transform change, subset change or combination.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_ps_ttm_sales_yield
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.frozen_hypothetical_formula: 1 / psTTM when psTTM is positive and finite
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.filters: positive finite psTTM only; no winsorization, neutralization or imputation
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: psTTM is absent from every accepted local daily and fundamental schema reviewed. Issuing a provider request merely to rescue the exhausted frontier is outside the frozen current-data campaign.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_pcf_ncf_ttm_cash_flow_yield
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.frozen_hypothetical_formula: 1 / pcfNcfTTM when pcfNcfTTM is positive and finite
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.filters: positive finite pcfNcfTTM only; no winsorization, neutralization or imputation
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: pcfNcfTTM is absent from the accepted local schemas. No point-in-time cash-flow valuation series can be reconstructed from the accepted quality aggregates without changing semantics.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: point_in_time_market_cap_or_free_float_scarcity
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_source_field: Tushare daily_basic.total_mv, circ_mv, total_share or free_share
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.frozen_hypothetical_formula: one minus same-day percentile rank of one preselected positive finite total_mv, circ_mv, total_share or free_share field
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.direction: higher means smaller capitalization or scarcer freely tradable share base
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.filters: one exact point-in-time field; no present-day listing snapshot, imputation, field switching, board subset or regime split
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The accepted contract has no market-cap or share-count field. A latest listing snapshot would leak present state into 2019-2023, while the separately frozen free-float scarcity branch is terminal at its no-return uniqueness gate and cannot be rerequested or reformulated.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: reconstructed_float_shares_or_market_cap_from_volume_turnover_and_price
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.frozen_hypothetical_formula: float_share_proxy = raw_volume / turnover; market_cap_proxy = raw_close * float_share_proxy
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.direction: one minus same-day percentile rank of the positive finite proxy
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.filters: positive finite inputs only; no handling of unit, zero-turnover or provider-denominator mismatch
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.subset_or_combination: raw turnover plus nominal price and volume
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Provider turnover denominator semantics, units and corporate-action timing are not sufficient to identify historical free shares. The reconstruction would combine terminal raw-turnover, nominal-price, activity and free-float domains and manufacture false precision rather than introduce a new source.

selection.reason: Four valuation fields and the required capitalization/share fields are outside the accepted local point-in-time contract; the PB and free-float branches are already terminal; the only raw-field reconstruction is a semantic proxy downgrade and terminal-domain recombination.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Begin Campaign139 only from a genuinely new prevalue mechanism already supported by an accepted historically versioned point-in-time source, or first run a separately authorized source-admission campaign; preserve all Campaign138 rejections and Candidate49 as the sole prospective ledger.
